tagline: Your data. Your rights. Your choices.
disclaimer: Educational only, not legal advice. No personal data is collected.

paragraphs: Data Story is a comic you play. You make choices for Meera and her friends, and see how India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025 protect people's data.
The stories are set in 2027–28, after the main Rules apply. Characters, apps and companies are made up.

A student project by Abel A Joy, LL.M. (Data Privacy and IT Law), Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Bengaluru. Not legal advice. Not affiliated with the Government of India or the Data Protection Board of India.
This game collects no personal data. Your progress is saved only on this device, and you can wipe it below.
The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may log visitors' IP addresses as part of hosting.
Best played on a laptop or desktop.
Read-aloud uses your browser's built-in voices.
Voices depend on your device. On a Mac, you can add better Indian English voices in System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System voice → Manage Voices → English (India).
